sample_mapping_evidence: Original GEO explicitly distinguishes patient1..4 PBMC RNA, two autoantibody-positive/two negative. Human host transcriptomes only; no inferred species, antibody target, clinical dates, or extra organism/tissue observations.

source_processing: The original sequencing data were analyzed by using FastQC software. 10X Chromium single cell transcriptome sequencing can be divided into three regions near the polyA and five regions near the transcriptional initiation site. Among them, 5-terminal transcript sequencing is usually performed together with T cell and B cell receptor gene TCR/BCR sequences for sequencing analysis. Different kits (including 3-terminal vs 5-terminal, and different versions) have slightly different library structures: For example, for a sample processed by a 10X single-cell 3-terminal V2 kit, Read 1 consists of a 16bp 10X Cell Barcode and a 10bp UMI sequence; The sample processed by the V3 kit, Read 1, consisted of 16 bp 10X Cell Barcode and 12 bp UMI sequence. In the analysis, 10X Cell Barcode in Read1 was used to separate individual cells, and UMI was used to remove PCR amplification bias and distinguish between transcripts. Read2 is a 151 bp cDNA sequence, and the first 91 bp is generally used for downstream analysis of Cell Ranger.
Supplementary files format and content: Matrix table wuth raw gene counts for every gene and every cell

title: NTM-infected, autoantibody-positive, scRNA seq of patient 1
extract_protocol_ch1: For the inspection and counting of single-cell suspension, the survival rate of cells is generally required to be above 85%, and the qualified cells are prepared by washing and re-suspension into a suitable cell concentration of 700~1200 cells/µl
